one_line: Open on the package, then let one family ritual and one specific worry carry a simple voiceover over page flips.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 hands hold a white MeBook.ai envelope over a bed, no face. 0:01 a toddler on the bed reaches for it. Voice from 0:00 (transcript): "יש לנו כלל בבית. לפני השינה קוראים ספר." First subtitle "כלל בית," by 0:02.
q1_hook.why: Motion and a child's reaction inside the first second, no greeting (H1, E1). A voice starts at once (H4). But it states a house rule, not what the book gives, and the first subtitle is tiny, so the point only lands around 0:12 to 0:18 (H2, T3).

beats.what: Hands hold the MeBook.ai envelope; a toddler reaches for it; cover art appears at 0:03
beats.why: Unboxing motion and a child's reaction from the first second

beats.what: Three close-ups of the cover art; subtitles "זה הזמן שלנו", "כמשפחה."
beats.why: Large clear pictures carry the bedtime-ritual voiceover

beats.what: One static shot: toddler lifts the book from the box, turns pages, reaches toward the camera at 0:17
beats.why: Real reaction, but ten seconds from one angle

beats.what: Over-the-shoulder close-up of the toddler's hand on a page with a glowing orb
beats.why: Brings the pictures close after the long wide shot

beats.what: Top-down page flips, toddler points at illustrations; "עוזר לו להבין את התפקיד החדש של כאח גדול."
beats.why: The new-sibling angle is the emotional reason, said over page flips

beats.what: Page flips; "Mebook זה לא סתם עוד ספר," then "ספר שמרגיש הכי" and "קרוב"
beats.why: Closing line sums up the claim; the brand is named once

beats.what: Back cover with a barcode and a round baby photo; last subtitle "שלנו."
beats.why: Ends on the product, no end card and no ask

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None in the video. The caption has no question and no ask to comment, share or save, only the coupon line.
q2_flow.why: Shots change every 1 to 3 s through 0:10. The static shot at 0:10 to 0:20 is the longest hold and adds only the toddler's movements (R1, R3). After it, page flips and the child pointing keep new visuals coming (R3, F8). Nothing is a tip or gift idea to send on (R5).

q3_cta.what: None in the video, spoken or written. Caption line 2: "קוד קופון - Lin10". No comment word, no link, no question.
q3_cta.why: One ask only, a coupon code (C1), and it is a real benefit, not engagement bait (C2). But it lives only in the caption: the video never says or shows it, so a viewer won by the last line sees no next step on screen (C6).

q4_shown.what: MeBook.ai envelope 0:00-0:03; cover art close-ups 0:03-0:10; toddler lifting the book out and turning pages 0:10-0:20; interior illustrations and text pages to 0:36; back cover with a round baby photo at 0:36. No price, no screen recording, no photo beside a page.
q4_shown.why: The book is handled from 0:02, early (S1). The parent's first-hand voice, "זה לא הספר הראשון", is a real vouch (S6). The cover shows an illustrated child with curly hair like the toddler's, but no photo sits beside it (S2). A toddler's face for 20 s is what LumeBook's own Reels avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: 12 shots in 39 s (about 3.3 s each). Plain cuts, no visible speed changes. Five cuts in 10 s, a static 10 s shot, then 2 to 4 s shots. Subtitles change every 1 to 2 s. Ends on the back cover.
q5_edit.why: A cut inside 1 s, then a new shot every 2 to 3 s, fits the moderate pace (E1, E2). Short subtitles under a continuous voice work muted (E4). The 10 s hold at 0:10 is long (R1). It stops on the product with a short tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: A parent's testimonial: bedtime reading is a family rule, and a book that looks like her children helps with a new big-sibling role (transcript, subtitle).
q6_topic.why: A new sibling and a bedtime routine are everyday parent concerns, and the claim is modest help, not a cure (K6, K4). The warmth comes from a family ritual, not a surprise or a joke, so energy stays medium (K1). A small arc: ritual, sibling role, "שלנו" (K2).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld vertical phone footage, mostly high angle. Close-up of hands with the envelope; a static medium shot of a toddler on a bed; over-the-shoulder and top-down close-ups of pages. Bright daylight, white wall, plush toys. An adult's hands help; no adult face.
q7_filmed.why: A home bed, daylight and handheld framing read as a parent's own video (H8, F7). Top-down close-ups fill the frame with pictures from the reader's seat (F5, F4), but the book is rotated, so the page text is hard to read. Full 9:16 frame, no borders (F1).

q8_text.on_screen: White subtitles, no box, 1 to 2 short lines about 85% down the frame, changing every 1 to 2 s: "כלל בית," (0:02), "זה הזמן שלנו" (0:05), "כמשפחה." (0:10), "זה לא הספר הראשון" (0:12), "אבל מרגישה" (0:20), "עוזר לו להבין את התפקיד החדש של כאח גדול." (0:26), "Mebook זה לא סתם עוד ספר," (0:32), "שלנו." (0:36). No headline card, no CTA text.
q8_text.caption: "לפעמים כל מה שילדים צריכים זה להרגיש חלק🤍". Three short lines, about 20 words: a mood line, "קוד קופון - Lin10", then "בשיתוף @mebook.ai". No question, no hashtags, no product keywords; paid-partnership label 0 in the 15 Oct data.
q8_text.why: Short subtitles echo the voice, so it works muted (T1, T2), but they are small and sit in the bottom 35% the Reels interface can cover (T4, F2). No headline card names the topic (T3). The caption has no searchable words or hashtags (T7); the disclosure is on its last line (T8).

weak_points: No hook text or promise before 0:12; a 10 s single-angle hold; tiny bottom subtitles; the code only in the caption; a transcript line about AI at 0:18, which LumeBook copy never says; a toddler's face throughout.
lumebook_takeaway: Hands open the package, then top-down page flips with a short voiceover on one bedtime ritual and one worry; end on the back cover with the offer on screen.
not_verified: Whether the toddler is the creator's child; whether music plays; the machine transcript is partly garbled. Correction to coded file: the transcript has an "AI" phrase at 0:18 to 0:20, but no burned-in subtitle shows at 0:18 and 0:19, and "אבל מרגישה" appears at 0:20, so the subtitles skip it. The cover title at 0:03 to 0:09 is printed on the book, not an overlay.
